parsed.name: OPX量子控制器
parsed.description: OPX是Quantum Machines推出的量子控制电子设备，用于在量子实验中生成、同步和执行精确的脉冲序列，触发测量并采集读出结果。它常用于超导量子比特等平台的实验编排、读出控制和自动化测量。
parsed.description_en: The OPX is a quantum control instrument from Quantum Machines used to generate, synchronize, and execute precise pulse sequences, trigger measurements, and acquire readout results in quantum experiments. It is commonly used for experiment orchestration, readout control, and automated measurements on platforms such as superconducting qubits.
